_meta.note: Bundled mirror of the published supported-providers reference. Kept in sync with apps/docs-site/src/content/docs/supported-providers.mdx by release discipline (a future version fetches this from the docs site directly). Used by the fit-assessment step; no numbers, no network.

supported_providers.summary: Stripe is the only payment provider XBorderCo integrates with today. All three Stripe integration types are supported.

integration_types.notes: No-code; the payment page lives on buy.stripe.com. Only available to certain Stripe customers, and there is a first-subscription dashboard caveat.
Also called Stripe Checkout Sessions. Your backend creates the session and redirects the customer to a Stripe-hosted page.
Stripe Elements inside your own pages. XBorderCo's preferred integration type — it gives the clearest view of the transaction.

roadmap_providers.notes: Integrations beyond Stripe are on the roadmap. If you use another provider and want to be in touch about future integrations, contact the XBorderCo team.

fit_guidance: Map the merchant's setup to a verdict. SUPPORTED if they run Stripe with any of Payment Links / Hosted Checkout / Embedded. ROADMAP if they use a non-Stripe provider (their obligations still hold; XBC support is on the roadmap — point them to a conversation). When you cannot tell the integration type, say so and proceed on 'Stripe, type unconfirmed'.
